summary: Wolfspeed filed an 8-K on October 7, 2026, disclosing a press release under Item 7.01 and, under Item 8.01, a conditional commitment letter with the U.S. Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital for a senior secured delayed-draw term loan of up to $1.5 billion. The facility comprises up to four tranches: a $600 million initial tranche and $900 million across remaining tranches of $200-400 million each. Terms contemplate a 30-year maturity and 36-month commitment period. Proceeds would refinance the 2030 first lien notes and fund project expenditures, subject to due diligence and definitive agreements.
